request: Reduce overall height of Nozzle Volcano part by 1mm, reduction should be made in threaded area.

actions.operation: Reduce the overall height of the part by shortening geometry within the threaded area.

parameters.reduction_direction: Axial direction of the nozzle, applied at the free upper end of the threaded shank

actions.target: Threaded area of the Nozzle Volcano part
actions.relational_constraint: The resulting overall part height must be 1 mm less, and the reduction must be made within the threaded area.
actions.unresolved_reference: Resolved as the long nozzle or threaded tip, S09. It is the longest of the three interchangeable nozzles, has a 21 mm axial envelope, and is visually identifiable in the multiview images by its extended threaded shank. S07 and S08 are the short and medium alternatives and are not to be modified.
steps: Isolate S09, Long nozzle or threaded tip, and suppress or hide S07 and S08 to prevent modification of the short and medium nozzle alternatives. Confirm S09 is the longest nozzle shown in the front, left, right, top-right isometric, top, and bottom views.

Establish the nozzle's overall-height direction from the common axis of the long axial orifice, face code 0085 and Brep FACE 1260. Use this axis as the datum axis for all axial dimensions, thread reconstruction, and verification measurements.

Treat the hexagonal wrench body, conical outlet tip, and lower shank root as retained geometry. In particular, preserve hex flat faces 0079 and 0080, hex upper face 0081, lower shank cylinder 0083, and conical outlet tip 0084.

Identify the modification region as the long external thread envelope, face code 0082 and Brep FACE 1264. Identify the upper axial boundary as the top seating annulus, face code 0086 and Brep FACE 1259. The internal bore intersecting this boundary is face code 0085.

If parametric feature history is available, edit the axial length dimension of the cylindrical threaded-shank blank. Reduce its extension from the hex-side reference by exactly 1 mm at the free upper end. Do not change the shank major diameter, minor diameter, thread pitch, thread form, or coaxial relationship with the axial orifice.

Regenerate the external thread feature on the shortened shank. Keep the existing thread handedness, pitch, profile angle, crest and root form, and radial dimensions. Reduce only the available axial thread extent by 1 mm and terminate the helix at the new upper boundary.

Move or regenerate top seating annulus 0086 so that it is exactly 1 mm closer to hex upper face 0081 along the nozzle axis. Keep the annulus planar, normal to the nozzle axis, and concentric with axial orifice 0085.

Maintain axial orifice 0085 as a through-all cut. If it was created by a blind-depth feature, reduce its terminal depth consistently with the shortened shank or replace it with a through-all cut so no internal cap or obstruction is created.

Recreate the upper thread lead-in or edge chamfer at the new threaded end using the original chamfer size and angle where recoverable. The chamfer must remain concentric and must not consume more thread length than the original lead-in.

If the model is an imported body without editable feature history, create a datum plane parallel to top seating annulus 0086 and offset it 1 mm toward the hex body. Split S09 with this plane, remove the upper 1 mm threaded cap, heal the remaining solid, and use the resulting planar annulus as the new upper end. Re-trim or reconstruct the final partial thread turn and restore the original lead-in chamfer.

Inspect the shortened thread for invalid sliver faces, open edges, self-intersections, or an incomplete helical termination. Confirm the solid remains watertight and that the thread envelope joins the retained lower runout without a discontinuity.
Measure between the new uppermost nozzle point and the unchanged lowermost conical-tip point along the established nozzle axis. Verify that the overall height has changed from 21 mm to 20 mm.

Verify that the modification is confined to S09 and principally affects threaded shank face 0082, top seating annulus 0086, and the terminal extent of axial orifice 0085. Confirm that S06 heater and nozzle block, including nozzle interface bore 0061, is not altered.

Perform an interference and engagement check between shortened S09 and S06 nozzle interface bore 0061. Confirm coaxial insertion remains possible and document that available threaded engagement is reduced by 1 mm while the thread diameter and pitch remain compatible.
